decisions.reason: As an organic extension close to our core charcuterie range and aligned with our stated expansion of organic lines, we would continue it because the launch investment and strategic fit argue for giving it more time.

This product combines organic positioning with a convenient snack format, was given a dedicated web presentation, and fits our announced assortment expansion, so management would be inclined to persist rather than withdraw early.

As a premium salami snack in a new sharing format but still near our established expertise, and with visible market introduction, we would keep it on the market and attribute any early uncertainty to the normal bedding-in phase.
